feat(editor): add page info menu for naming and describing pages (#160)
open False
master
Closes #160

## Why

Issue #160 (child of #149, depends on #157). After #157, pages could be created and switched, but each one was only "Page N" based on its position, with no way to tell pages apart or note what they're for. This sub-issue adds a page info menu so users can rename pages, add a description, hide or show a page's thumbnail and set each page's own grid. Pages become easier to organize, and the info can be read by hovering a tab.

## What changed

- **Data model (`packages/excalidraw/pages.ts`):** `DrawingPage` gains:
  - `name: string`: new pages get the first free "Page N" name, so default names never repeat.
  - `description: string`: empty by default.
  - `showThumbnail: boolean`: `true` by default.
- **Validation helpers (`pages.ts`):** `validatePageInfo` and `isPageInfoValid`, the single source for the rules:
  - Names can't be empty or whitespace only.
  - Names must be unique (trimmed, ignoring case).
  - Names are at most 50 characters (`PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH`).
  - Descriptions are at most 350 characters (`PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH`).
  - `getNextDefaultPageName` generates the default names.
- **Page info menu (new `PageInfoDialog.tsx` / `.scss`):**
  - It opens in a read-only view showing the name, the description (only when there is one), thumbnail shown/hidden and a grid summary.
  - **Edit** switches to a form with: name, description (with an `n/350` counter), show thumbnail, show grid, snap to grid and grid size.
  - Inline errors explain why a page can't be saved, and **Save** stays disabled until everything is valid.
  - **Cancel** throws away the edits. **Close**, Escape or clicking outside closes without changing anything.
- **Opening the menu:**
  - Right-click a page tab, or press **F2** on a focused tab. Both open *that* page's menu without switching to it.
  - **Alt+Shift+I** (new `actionOpenPageInfo`) opens the menu for the current page from anywhere.
  - Both shortcuts are listed in the Help dialog.
- **Page tabs (`Pages.tsx`):**
  - Tabs show the page's name (also used as the accessible name), cut off with "…" when too long.
  - Hovering a tab shows its description in a tooltip. Pages without a description get no tooltip.
  - Hiding the thumbnail replaces the preview with a small page icon and skips rendering the preview.
- **Per-page grid (`App.tsx` `updatePageInfo`):**
  - Grid changes for a page that isn't open are stored on that page only. The current page and other pages are untouched.
  - Grid changes for the open page apply right away.
  - Turning the grid on at opacity 0 restores full opacity, the same as the existing Ctrl+' toggle.
  - `updatePageInfo` re-checks and trims the name itself, so code that skips the UI still can't save an invalid name.
- **Keyboard handling:** other shortcuts are ignored while the menu is open, so typing in it can't trigger tools.
- **i18n:** new `pageInfoDialog` section and `labels.pageInfo` in `en.json`.

## Tech Debt

### Introduced

- **Not saved yet.** Names, descriptions and thumbnail settings live in `App`'s private page list, like the rest of #157's page data, so they're lost on reload. Saving and loading pages is out of scope for this issue.
- **Default names keep their original language.** "Page N" is filled in from `t("labels.page")` when the page is created, so it doesn't follow a later language change.
- **The 50-character name limit is my choice.** The issue only sets a limit for descriptions (350).
- **Changes can't be undone.** Edits made through the page info menu don't go into undo history. Page-specific undo/redo is out of scope.
- **The shortcut matches the physical I key.** Alt+Shift+I checks `event.code === "KeyI"` so it works with Option on macOS. On non-QWERTY layouts it's whichever key sits where I is on QWERTY.
- **Leftovers:**
  - `getPageForInfo` (on `AppClassProperties`) isn't used by the UI, since `LayerUI` looks the page up itself.
  - The `page-navigation__item--no-thumbnail` class has no CSS rule yet.
- **Long descriptions make a tall tooltip.** A 350-character description shows as a 50ch-wide tooltip of about 7–8 lines.
- New UI strings were added to `en.json` only.

### Encountered

- **Pages aren't React state.** They're private fields on `App` (from #157), so changing them doesn't re-render. `updatePageInfo` relies on its `setState` call to refresh the tabs.
- **The current page's settings live in two places.** They're in `this.state` and get copied into the page by `saveActivePage()`. So grid edits for the current page must go through `setState`, or they'd be overwritten on the next page switch.
- **Vitest also picks up the stray `.tmp-ai-logs-wt/` checkout.** The full suite runs twice (about 30 min), font fetches fail, and failures appear that aren't real.
- **`yarn fix` fails** with an `@typescript-eslint` plugin conflict from the nested `excalidraw-room` config. ESLint and Prettier were run on the changed files directly instead.
- **Some tests fail only under full-suite load:** `collabLock`, `actionDuplicateSelection` and `maskGroup` pass when run on their own. The 20K-element `fractionalIndex` performance test fails independently of this change.
- **`yarn test:update` deleted the "with a CJK font 2" export snapshot** while font fetches were failing. That change was reverted.

## Test Evidence

| Acceptance criterion | Test(s) | Level | Source of expected value |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1a: Open the menu by right-clicking a tab or with a shortcut; it opens the intended page even if that page isn't current | `pages.test.tsx`: "opens the menu for a right-clicked inactive page without switching pages", "opens with keyboard shortcuts" | integration | AC |
| 1b: Menu shows the page's unique name, description and hide/show thumbnail option | `pages.test.tsx`: "opens the menu for a right-clicked inactive page without switching pages", "renames a page and shows its description on hover", "hides a page's thumbnail" | integration | AC |
| 1c: Save or cancel changes explicitly | `pages.test.tsx`: "renames a page and shows its description on hover", "cancel discards unsaved changes" | integration | AC |
| 1d: Cancel restores the saved info; closing without changes doesn't modify the page | `pages.test.tsx`: "cancel discards unsaved changes" | integration | AC |
| 1e: Grid settings are per page, don't affect other pages or global preferences, and are kept when switching pages | `pages.test.tsx`: "keeps grid settings per page", "updates the active page's grid immediately", "creates pages and restores their elements, settings, and viewport" | integration | AC |
| 2a: Rename a page; add, edit or remove a description | `pages.test.tsx`: "renames a page and shows its description on hover" | integration | AC |
| 2b: Changes show in the tab; description shown on hover or when the menu is reopened | `pages.test.tsx`: "renames a page and shows its description on hover". Manual: [rename a page, hover its tab, reopen its menu, and confirm the new name and description show; fill in what you saw] | integration, manual | AC |
| 2c: Long descriptions don't overflow; over 350 characters can't be saved | `pages.test.tsx`: "blocks saving invalid names and overly long descriptions", "validates page names and descriptions" | unit, integration | AC |
| 2d: Names can't be empty or whitespace; empty descriptions don't show empty metadata | `pages.test.tsx`: "validates page names and descriptions", "blocks saving invalid names and overly long descriptions", "generates the next free default page name", "renames a page and shows its description on hover" (pages without a description get no tooltip) | unit, integration | AC |

**Not tested automatically, and why:**
- Whether long names and descriptions actually wrap, get cut off or scroll without overflowing (part of 2c) is CSS layout, which jsdom doesn't compute. Tests check the 350-character rule. The visual result was left to manual checking.
- Tooltip placement near the screen edges uses the existing `Tooltip` component and needs real layout.
- These dialog controls aren't covered by tests in this PR: the snap-to-grid switch, the grid-size input, and Enter-to-save. Snap and size go through the same per-page path as show-grid, which is tested.

**How expected values were checked:** I first looked over every test that the AI edited or added and saw if they didn't make sense or were pointless; then I tested manually in the frontend by testing in the app and seeing if it worked correctly. If something wasn't exactly right or highly sensitive, I look over the test again. Not for if they didn't make sense or were pointless, but if they did make seem useful.

+/** Opens the page info menu for the active page (Alt+Shift+I). */
+export const actionOpenPageInfo = register({
+  name: "openPageInfo",
+  label: "labels.pageInfo",
+  keywords: ["page", "rename", "description"],
+  viewMode: false,
+  trackEvent: { category: "canvas" },
+  perform(elements, appState, _, app) {
+    return {
+      appState: {
+        ...appState,
+        openDialog: { name: "pageInfo", pageId: app.getActivePageId() },
+      },
+      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY,
+    };
+  },
+  // physical key code so Option+Shift+I on macOS (which produces "ˆ") works
+  keyTest: (event) =>
+    event.altKey &&
+    event.shiftKey &&
+    !event[KEYS.CTRL_OR_CMD] &&
+    event.code === "KeyI",
+});

diff --git a/packages/excalidraw/components/PageInfoDialog.tsx b/packages/excalidraw/components/PageInfoDialog.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..6994f91b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/excalidraw/components/PageInfoDialog.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,266 @@
+import { useState } from "react";
+
+import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";
+
+import { t } from "../i18n";
+import {
+  PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
+  PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH,
+  isPageInfoValid,
+  validatePageInfo,
+} from "../pages";
+import { getNormalizedGridSize } from "../scene/normalize";
+
+import { CheckboxItem } from "./CheckboxItem";
+import { Dialog } from "./Dialog";
+import DialogActionButton from "./DialogActionButton";
+import { Switch } from "./Switch";
+import { TextField } from "./TextField";
+
+import "./PageInfoDialog.scss";
+
+import type { DrawingPage, PageInfoPatch } from "../pages";
+import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
+
+const getPatchFromPage = (page: DrawingPage): PageInfoPatch => ({
+  name: page.name,
+  description: page.description,
+  showThumbnail: page.showThumbnail,
+  grid: {
+    gridModeEnabled: page.settings.gridModeEnabled,
+    gridSnapEnabled: page.settings.gridSnapEnabled,
+    gridSize: page.settings.gridSize,
+  },
+});
+
+/**
+ * Shows a page's name, description and settings, and lets the user edit them.
+ * Changes are kept in a local draft until explicitly saved.
+ */
+export const PageInfoDialog = ({
+  page,
+  pages,
+  onSave,
+  onClose,
+}: {
+  page: DrawingPage;
+  pages: readonly DrawingPage[];
+  onSave: (patch: PageInfoPatch) => void;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}) => {
+  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<PageInfoPatch | null>(null);
+  // keep the raw text so the field can be cleared while typing
+  const [gridSizeInput, setGridSizeInput] = useState("");
+
+  const startEditing = () => {
+    const initial = getPatchFromPage(page);
+    setDraft(initial);
+    setGridSizeInput(String(initial.grid.gridSize));
+  };
+
+  const cancelEditing = () => {
+    setDraft(null);
+  };
+
+  const validation = draft
+    ? validatePageInfo(draft, pages, page.id)
+    : { nameError: undefined, descriptionError: undefined };
+  const canSave = !!draft && isPageInfoValid(validation);
+
+  const handleSave = () => {
+    if (!draft || !canSave) {
+      return;
+    }
+    onSave({ ...draft, name: draft.name.trim() });
+  };
+
+  const handleNameKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
+    if (event.key === KEYS.ENTER) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      handleSave();
+    }
+  };
+
+  const updateDraft = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch>) => {
+    setDraft((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, ...patch } : prev));
+  };
+
+  const updateGrid = (patch: Partial<PageInfoPatch["grid"]>) => {
+    setDraft((prev) =>
+      prev ? { ...prev, grid: { ...prev.grid, ...patch } } : prev,
+    );
+  };
+
+  const nameErrorMessage =
+    validation.nameError === "empty"
+      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.emptyName")
+      : validation.nameError === "duplicate"
+      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.duplicateName")
+      : validation.nameError === "tooLong"
+      ? t("pageInfoDialog.errors.nameTooLong", { max: PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH })
+      : null;
+
+  const renderView = () => (
+    <>
+      <dl className="PageInfoDialog__details">
+        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.name")}</dt>
+        <dd className="PageInfoDialog__name">{page.name}</dd>
+        {page.description && (
+          <>
+            <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.description")}</dt>
+            <dd className="PageInfoDialog__description">{page.description}</dd>
+          </>
+        )}
+        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnail")}</dt>
+        <dd>
+          {page.showThumbnail
+            ? t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnailShown")
+            : t("pageInfoDialog.thumbnailHidden")}
+        </dd>
+        <dt>{t("pageInfoDialog.grid")}</dt>
+        <dd>
+          {page.settings.gridModeEnabled
+            ? t("pageInfoDialog.gridShown")
+            : t("pageInfoDialog.gridHidden")}
+          {" · "}
+          {page.settings.gridSnapEnabled
+            ? t("pageInfoDialog.snapOn")
+            : t("pageInfoDialog.snapOff")}
+          {" · "}
+          {t("pageInfoDialog.gridSize")}: {page.settings.gridSize}
+        </dd>
+      </dl>
+      <div className="PageInfoDialog__actions">
+        <DialogActionButton label={t("buttons.close")} onClick={onClose} />
+        <DialogActionButton
+          label={t("buttons.edit")}
+          onClick={startEditing}
+          actionType="primary"
+        />
+      </div>
+    </>
+  );
+
+  const renderEdit = (draft: PageInfoPatch) => (
+    <>
+      <div className="PageInfoDialog__fields">
+        <div>
+          <TextField
+            label={t("pageInfoDialog.name")}
+            value={draft.name}
+            onChange={(name) => updateDraft({ name })}
+            onKeyDown={handleNameKeyDown}
+            selectOnRender
+            fullWidth
+          />
+          {nameErrorMessage && (
+            <div className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
+              {nameErrorMessage}
+            </div>
+          )}
+        </div>
+        <label className="PageInfoDialog__textarea">
+          <span className="PageInfoDialog__label">
+            {t("pageInfoDialog.description")}
+          </span>
+          <textarea
+            value={draft.description}
+            placeholder={t("pageInfoDialog.descriptionPlaceholder")}
+            rows={4}
+            onChange={(event) =>
+              updateDraft({ description: event.target.value })
+            }
+            aria-invalid={!!validation.descriptionError}
+          />
+          <span
+            className={
+              validation.descriptionError
+                ? "PageInfoDialog__counter PageInfoDialog__counter--error"
+                : "PageInfoDialog__counter"
+            }
+          >
+            {t("pageInfoDialog.charCount", {
+              count: draft.description.length,
+              max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
+            })}
+          </span>
+          {validation.descriptionError && (
+            <span className="PageInfoDialog__error" role="alert">
+              {t("pageInfoDialog.errors.descriptionTooLong", {
+                max: PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
+              })}
+            </span>
+          )}
+        </label>
+        <CheckboxItem
+          checked={draft.showThumbnail}
+          onChange={(showThumbnail) => updateDraft({ showThumbnail })}
+        >
+          {t("pageInfoDialog.showThumbnail")}
+        </CheckboxItem>
+        <fieldset className="PageInfoDialog__grid">
+          <legend>{t("pageInfoDialog.grid")}</legend>
+          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
+            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}</span>
+            <Switch
+              name="page-info-grid-mode"
+              title={t("pageInfoDialog.showGrid")}
+              checked={draft.grid.gridModeEnabled}
+              onChange={(gridModeEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridModeEnabled })}
+            />
+          </label>
+          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
+            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}</span>
+            <Switch
+              name="page-info-grid-snap"
+              title={t("pageInfoDialog.snapToGrid")}
+              checked={draft.grid.gridSnapEnabled}
+              onChange={(gridSnapEnabled) => updateGrid({ gridSnapEnabled })}
+            />
+          </label>
+          <label className="PageInfoDialog__row">
+            <span>{t("pageInfoDialog.gridSize")}</span>
+            <input
+              className="PageInfoDialog__number"
+              type="number"
+              min={1}
+              max={100}
+              value={gridSizeInput}
+              onChange={(event) => {
+                setGridSizeInput(event.target.value);
+                const value = Number(event.target.value);
+                if (event.target.value !== "" && Number.isFinite(value)) {
+                  updateGrid({ gridSize: getNormalizedGridSize(value) });
+                }
+              }}
+              onBlur={() => setGridSizeInput(String(draft.grid.gridSize))}
+            />
+          </label>
+        </fieldset>
+      </div>
+      <div className="PageInfoDialog__actions">
+        <DialogActionButton
+          label={t("buttons.cancel")}
+          onClick={cancelEditing}
+        />
+        <DialogActionButton
+          label={t("pageInfoDialog.save")}
+          onClick={handleSave}
+          actionType="primary"
+          disabled={!canSave}
+        />
+      </div>
+    </>
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <Dialog
+      size="small"
+      onCloseRequest={onClose}
+      title={t("pageInfoDialog.title")}
+      className="PageInfoDialog"
+    >
+      {draft ? renderEdit(draft) : renderView()}
+    </Dialog>
+  );
+};

+
+  // only show the hover metadata when there is something to show
+  return page.description ? (
+    <Tooltip label={page.description} long>
+      {tab}
+    </Tooltip>
+  ) : (
+    tab
+  );
+};

diff --git a/packages/excalidraw/pages.ts b/packages/excalidraw/pages.ts
index bfffa373..fb3bc6e5 100644
--- a/packages/excalidraw/pages.ts
+++ b/packages/excalidraw/pages.ts
@@ -26,10 +26,83 @@ export type PageSettings = Pick<

 export type DrawingPage = Readonly<{
   id: string;
+  name: string;
+  description: string;
+  showThumbnail: boolean;
   elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[];
   settings: PageSettings;
 }>;

+export const PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 50;
+export const PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH = 350;
+
+export type PageGridSettings = Pick<
+  PageSettings,
+  "gridModeEnabled" | "gridSnapEnabled" | "gridSize"
+>;
+
+export type PageInfoPatch = {
+  name: string;
+  description: string;
+  showThumbnail: boolean;
+  grid: PageGridSettings;
+};
+
+export type PageInfoValidation = {
+  nameError?: "empty" | "duplicate" | "tooLong";
+  descriptionError?: "tooLong";
+};
+
+const normalizePageName = (name: string) => name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
+
+/**
+ * Returns `${baseName} N` using the smallest N >= 1 whose name isn't already
+ * taken (case-insensitively) by another page.
+ */
+export const getNextDefaultPageName = (
+  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "name">[],
+  baseName: string,
+): string => {
+  const taken = new Set(pages.map((page) => normalizePageName(page.name)));
+  let index = 1;
+  while (taken.has(normalizePageName(`${baseName} ${index}`))) {
+    index++;
+  }
+  return `${baseName} ${index}`;
+};
+
+export const validatePageInfo = (
+  info: { name: string; description: string },
+  pages: readonly Pick<DrawingPage, "id" | "name">[],
+  pageId: string,
+): PageInfoValidation => {
+  const result: PageInfoValidation = {};
+  const trimmedName = info.name.trim();
+
+  if (!trimmedName) {
+    result.nameError = "empty";
+  } else if (trimmedName.length > PAGE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
+    result.nameError = "tooLong";
+  } else if (
+    pages.some(
+      (page) =>
+        page.id !== pageId &&
+        normalizePageName(page.name) === normalizePageName(trimmedName),
+    )
+  ) {
+    result.nameError = "duplicate";
+  }
+
+  if (info.description.length > PAGE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH) {
+    result.descriptionError = "tooLong";
+  }
+
+  return result;
+};
+
+export const isPageInfoValid = (validation: PageInfoValidation) =>
+  !validation.nameError && !validation.descriptionError;
